 The Three-Belt Unification Showdown between Emanuel Navarrete and O’Shaquie Foster is set for Saturday, Oct. 24 at the Frost Bank Center in San Antonio, Texas. The main card begins at 5 p.m. PT/8 p.m. ET and airs exclusively on DAZN , with subscriptions starting at $24.99 per month .
 watch Navarrete vs. Foster on dazn 
 At a Glance: How to Watch Emanuel Navarrete vs. O’Shaquie Foster 
 Date: Saturday, Oct. 24
 Time: preliminary card starts at 2:30 p.m. PT/5:30 p.m. ET; main card starts at 5 p.m. PT/8 p.m. ET
 Stream online: DAZN 
 Where to Watch Navarrete vs. Foster: Streaming Date, Schedule 
 With three belts at stake, IBF and WBO champion Emanuel Navarrete (40-2-1) takes on WBC titlist O’Shaquie Foster (25-3) on Saturday, Oct. 24. The Three-Belt Unification Showdown will air exclusively on DAZN .

 Prelims begin at 2:30 p.m. PT/5:30 p.m. ET, while the main card isn’t until 5 p.m. PT/8 p.m. ET. The main event ring walks are expected around 7 p.m. PT/10 p.m. ET.
 watch Navarrete vs. Foster 
 DAZN Boxing Subscription: Plans, Pricing 
 To catch tonight’s super featherweight unification bout between Emanuel Navarrete and O’Shaquie Foster, fans will need either a DAZN Standard subscription (starting at $24.99 per month) or a DAZN Ultimate subscription (starting at $49.99 per month). 
 Both plans include 185-plus fights per year from the best promoters. The main difference between the two is that Standard subscribers incur an additional cost for pay-per-view events, while Ultimate subscribers receive a minimum of 12 pay-per-views a year included at no extra cost.
 Further compare the two packages and sign up now at Dazn.com .
